# config/v2-runtime-boundary-allowlist.txt
# Paths excluded from the v2 runtime-boundary scan
# (scripts/gates/v2-runtime-boundary.py). One prefix per line; '#' comments.
#
# Excluded classes:
#   - tests and fixtures live inside #[cfg(test)] regions and are also
#     skipped structurally by the scanner itself
#   - generated files (lockfiles, dist, target)
#   - provenance, legal, dispatch, and guard tooling paths that must be
#     able to NAME forbidden executables in order to forbid them

# Provenance and import staging (never release runtime code).
imports/

# Attached Cutaway/Finish golden-behavior material: provenance_only per
# imports/v2/dispositions.json; live execution migrates to typed stages.
cutaway/
finish/

# Documentation, legal notices, and dispatch evidence.
docs/

# Guard tooling and repo scripts name forbidden executables by design.
scripts/

# Development-only tooling (import-closure, evals) is not release code.
tools/

# Third-party notice aggregation.
third_party/

# Generated build output and dependencies.
target/
node_modules/
dist/
.git/

# Lockfiles and generated manifests.
Cargo.lock
pnpm-lock.yaml
package-lock.json
